# api-catalog

API (monolito o API simple)

## Endpoints

| Method | Path | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| GET | / | Health check |
| GET | /api/v1/catalog | List items |
| POST | /api/v1/catalog | Create item |

## Getting Started

```bash
make run
```

## Build

```bash
make build
```
